data.why: Repo ships pre-fetched, pre-classified ClinicalTrials.gov snapshots under snapshots/<date>/ (trials.csv, sites.csv, prisma.json, metadata.json); on startup the app tries a live ClinicalTrials.gov fetch, and since the sandbox has no runtime network it automatically falls back to loading the most recent bundled snapshot, so no files need to be written or uploaded.

goals: Survey the current CAR-T/CAR-NK oncology clinical trial landscape by disease branch, category, and entity
Identify which antigen targets are most heavily pursued versus under-explored ('white space') across heme and solid tumors
Compare trial activity, phase distribution, and sponsor competition for a specific target antigen or disease over time
Map the geographic distribution of trial sites and recruitment hotspots by country/region
Track approved-product milestones (FDA/EMA/NMPA/CDSCO) against the broader pipeline to gauge translational maturity
Generate publication-ready figures and provenance-tagged CSV exports summarizing a filtered slice of the landscape

review.summary: The tree gets the dashboard's purpose right: freeze a dated registry snapshot, filter by disease hierarchy, map sites, profile targets and products for white space, and export provenance-tagged CSVs and figures. Every screen I opened matches its node. It still needs fixes before filing: the Methods/PRISMA tab, Figures 2–12 and the confidence and target filters are missing, and the checker could not confirm 9 of 17 tasks and 5 of 10 features.
